checks.explanation: UATX did open in fall 2024 as predicted, but the class size claim doesn't hold up well: the inaugural cohort was 92 students, well under half of Caltech's roughly 235-student freshman class (and a small fraction of Caltech's ~900-student total undergraduate body), so 'comparable to Caltech's student body' overstates the actual size even though both are small, elite institutions.

sources.title: University of Austin enters its first academic year
